clips.title: The story
paras: Inside Shadowfang Keep, Deathstalker Vincent lies slain by Arugal. The Forsaken scout entered the stronghold with Deathstalker Adamant to learn its defenses, but the mission ended before the Forsaken could attack.

The Deathstalkers needed to learn Shadowfang Keep’s layout before the Forsaken could assault it. Vincent and Adamant slipped past the barricades into the fortress. Their mission failed: Adamant was captured and locked in a dungeon cell, while Vincent was brought before the keep’s master. Vincent refused to serve Arugal or yield to him. The mage executed him, leaving his body on the stone floor.
